title: Fixed Open Case C Tube and Pointer Link Display
description: One newly authored complete static open-case C-tube instrument-style exhibit. A continuous shallow round backed cup on a complete foot and lower support exposes one whole flattened C-curved metal-like tube exterior. Its lower end is fixed in a full block, while its other end joins a complete short pinned link to a separate tooth-edged sector. An independently supported small tooth-edged pinion, fixed shaft and whole long blank pointer sit before the open mechanism; a narrow blank reference arc has two real rear seats. Unlike a closed cuff-gauge face or a capsule-stack pen drum, the visible curved tube-tip/link/sector/pointer relationship defines this complete newly authored object. No old gauge or mechanism vertices imported. Three opaque PBR roles, metres Z up, one model zero scenes. The tube is a closed exterior solid, not a modelled fluid bore; no transparent cover or calibrated marks. Static illustrative appearance only, not a functional pressure instrument. No pressure containment, fluid path, deformation, gearing accuracy, motion solution, readings, calibration, manufacture, operation or safety performance. Rigging animation interaction not made.
